summary.headline: Moon–Mercury Conjunction in Triplicities
summary.text: Astrological omens of the Moon–Mercury conjunction, including effects in the fiery, earthy, and watery triplicities and in Sagittarius: political movement, messengers, weather, rain, winds, markets, war, disease, death, and social behavior.
